title: PFISTERER x VfB Stuttgart | PFISTERER
content: From the region, for the region. PFISTERER is a team partner. # **PFISTERER is now an official team partner of VfB Stuttgart**. “VfB Stuttgart stands for passion, team spirit, and the will to succeed. With this partnership, we not only want to strengthen our brand, but also show the people in the region that we are rooted here and take responsibility,” explains Dr. Konstantin Kurfiss, member of the Executive Board at PFISTERER. VfB Stuttgart also emphasizes the special significance of this connection: "We warmly welcome PFISTERER to our family of partners and are delighted that another hidden champion from our strong economic and innovation region is supporting and enriching VfB Stuttgart. PFISTERER and VfB are clearly committed to our home region, and we are both pursuing the goal of steady international growth with great ambition," says Rouven Kasper, Chief Marketing and Sales Officer at VfB Stuttgart. With almost 150,000 members, VfB Stuttgart is the largest sports club in Baden-Württemberg and a club steeped in tradition.

title: Porsche AG joins VfB Stuttgart as an investor - Porsche Newsroom
content: Alexander Wehrle (VfB Stuttgart), Britta Seeger (Mercedes-Benz), Lutz Meschke (Porsche), Dr. Ralf Hofmann (MHP) und Claus Vogt (VfB Stuttgart), 2024, Porsche AG. # Porsche AG joins VfB Stuttgart as an investor. Porsche AG is joining football Bundesliga team VfB Stuttgart as an investor. Additionally, in the coming years the company is making a comprehensive commitment to VfB Stuttgart as a sponsor, supporting the youth development centre among other things. As announced in June 2023, in the first step Porsche AG is acquiring 5.49 per cent of the shares of VfB Stuttgart 1893 AG. As part of its commitment, Porsche is also taking two seats on the Supervisory Board of VfB Stuttgart 1893 AG. The Management and IT Consultancy MHP, a subsidiary of Porsche AG, has owned the name rights for the MHP Arena Stuttgart since the start of this season. title: VfB Stuttgart - Wikipedia
content: # VfB Stuttgart. Association football club in Germany. 'Association for Movement Games Stuttgart 1893'), commonly known as **VfB Stuttgart** (German pronunciation:  ⓘ), is a German professional sports club based in Stuttgart, Baden-Württemberg. The club's football team is currently part of Germany's first division, the Bundesliga. VfB Stuttgart has won the national championship five times, most recently in 2006–07, the DFB-Pokal four times and the UEFA Intertoto Cup a record two times. In the all-time Bundesliga table the club sits in fourth place. Second team side VfB Stuttgart II currently plays in the 3. Due to disappointing results in international competition including the 1958 and 1962 FIFA World Cup, and in response to the growth of professionalism in the sport, the German Football Association (DFB) replaced the regional top flight competitions with a single nationwide professional league in 1963. In 1973, the team qualified for the UEFA Cup for the first time and advanced to the semi-finals of the 1974 tournament where they were eliminated by eventual winners Feyenoord (1–2, 2–2).
